# Icon Catalog

<!-- Generated by tools/generate_icons.py -- do not edit by hand. -->

60 monochrome vector icons on a 24x24 grid, one file per icon,
across 8 domain directories. Every file is emitted from
`ShapeLibrary._ICON_CATALOG` by tools/generate_icons.py, so these files and
the glyphs the renderer draws are the same artwork by construction.

Every icon is stroked at 2px on the 24x24 grid and uses `currentColor`, so it inherits its color from the embedding document. 2 of 60 add a lighter accent stroke for interior detail: `historian` (1.5px), `vector_db` (1.2px).

## Aliases

60 canonical names above. Some are vendor or product names (`grafana`,
`kafka`, `s3`, `docker`): they are conveniences that resolve to the generic
glyph named below. No vendor logo or trademarked mark is reproduced, and all
product names remain the property of their respective owners.

## Regenerating

```bash
uv run python tools/generate_icons.py           # rewrite this directory
uv run python tools/generate_icons.py --check   # verify it is current
```

Add an icon by adding its glyph to `ShapeLibrary._render_icon_content` and
its row to `ShapeLibrary._ICON_CATALOG`, then regenerate. Editing files in
this directory by hand has no effect on rendering and will be overwritten.
